title: Evaluation preserved by strictification
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit with $n>0$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a designated output vertex. Suppose each gate has distinct arguments, every NOT gate has one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. For every Boolean input assignment $x$, the strictified circuit has the same output value as $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit with $n$ inputs, gates in topological order, and a valid designated output
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to the $n$ inputs
